overall_summary: The channel shows a clear preference for 'Husband-Wife' relationship dynamics over generic family or motivational content. High-performing videos (1600+ views) focus on marital realities, while generic emotional shayari or broad family topics perform significantly lower.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos 'पत्नी की ये बात...' (1666 views) and 'Shaadi Ke Baad...' (1764 views) are the top performers.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on husband-wife relationship conflicts and realizations.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक' (19 views) and 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा' (6 views) show low engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetry; focus on concrete, specific life scenarios.

next_video.hook_style: Direct question about a common marital habit
next_video.story_structure: Wife waiting for husband to finish work -> The silence of the house at night -> The realization that they are living together but not talking.

next_video.twist_direction: Reveal that the silence isn't peace, it's the distance between two people in the same room.
next_video.reason: Historical data shows peak performance for relationship-based content posted in the early morning window.
